response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_of_telescope_averages FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - g.avg_of_telescope_averages AS amount_above_average, t.avg_modindex / g.avg_of_telescope_averages AS ratio_to_group_average FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE t.avg_modindex > g.avg_of_telescope_averages ORDER BY ratio_to_group_average DESC LIMIT 10;
